Meidensha.why: Japanese maker of transformers and power T&D equipment; data-center construction and grid build-out drive transformer demand, which it is meeting with a plant expansion (about 1.5x capacity) and higher Power Infrastructure sales.
Meidensha.evidence: Meidensha press release (10-30-2025): JPY 160 hundred million investment in a new building at the Numazu transformer plant to raise capacity to about 1.5 times, citing rising power demand from data center construction.

players.product: Power transformers and substation / transmission-and-distribution equipment, including SF6 gas-free products; Numazu transformer plant expansion to about 1.5x capacity

quarterly_data.signal: Meidensha decided to invest JPY 160 hundred million to add a new building (exterior assembly and test hall) at the transformer plant of its Numazu Works (Shizuoka), part of the JPY 350 hundred million growth investment in its Medium-term Management Plan 2027, targeting operation start in fiscal 2028; together with standardized transformer specifications to shorten lead times, production-process DX and more staff, it aims to raise transformer production capacity to about 1.5 times the current level. Rationale stated: transformer demand is rising with the revenue-cap system in the power sector, higher power demand from data center construction and grid expansion for renewables; the goal is stable supply to transmission and distribution operators and all customers needing transformers. The group is also investing in factories in Japan, the U.S., India and Singapore
quarterly_data.figure: JPY 160 hundred million; capacity about 1.5 times; operation from fiscal 2028
